items.title: Why the Long Nose?
items.task: Look at the train’s nose. Why would engineers make it this shape?
items.reveal: A long nose helps the train move air aside. That cuts noise and the punch of air in tunnels.

moreInfo.title: Tunnel boom
moreInfo.text: A fast train entering a tunnel squeezes air. The long nose spreads that squeeze so nearby towns hear less boom. Check the exact engineering words before live.

items.notes: Confirm tunnel-pressure / boom wording. Do not invent damper numbers or series names.
